correctness.rationale: Conjugation of intrinsic displacement translations yields common L on 2A, and the complete compatibility equation is necessary and sufficient. The surjection A/2A -> 2A/4A has t fibers each of size u; count coset-permutation lifts and t choices in each nonzero fiber. The resulting order formula is proved for arbitrary finite abelian A. The 1/2/4 index criterion is checked against standard rank-two abelian 2-group automorphism orders. Exhaustive permutation and constructive checks reproduce 128 for R2×R4 and 6144 for R4×R4; these are independent tests, not proof substitutes.

originality.rationale: A concrete unanswered question in arXiv:2610.18676 Question 3.5 is resolved. Earlier work establishes the Latin/no-2-torsion case, single factors, inner automorphisms, and an equal-exponent 2-power special case. The new result handles all mixed 2-primary types and gives the sharp two-cyclic affine-index criterion. Related group-action equations were compared, rather than merely paper titles. Unindexed equivalents remain possible.

value.rationale: A concrete October 2026 question about even direct products is solved for all m,n and, more strongly, all finite abelian core quandles. Mixed exponent-one and higher 2-primary components introduce factorial fiber-permutation symmetries; R2×R4 has a new index-two nonaffine phenomenon. General exact classification and the sharp affine-index transition are structurally motivated and not an arbitrary small enumerative slice.
